Summary: The sources provide conflicting information regarding the total parameters of DeepSeek-V3.1. According to the blog post on bdtechtalks.substack.com, DeepSeek-V3.1 has 685 billion parameters. However, the technical analysis on runpod.io states that DeepSeek-V3.1 has 671 billion total parameters. Additionally, the Hugging Face page and the arXiv technical report both mention a total size of 685B, which includes 671B of the Main Model weights and 14B of the Multi-Token Prediction Module weights. The guide on bentoml.com also lists DeepSeek-V3.1 with 671B parameters. Thus, the exact number of parameters for DeepSeek-V3.1 remains unclear based on the provided sources.
